scenes.description: Benny Hiding Behind the Tall Armchair in the Living Room
A Cute Kitten Sleeping Under the Wooden Table
Finding the Surprise Gift Between Two Soft Pillows

character_line.en: Ready or not, here I come! Where am I hiding?
character_line.zh: 準備好了沒，我來囉！我躲在哪裡呢？

options.en: You are hiding behind the big green armchair!
options.zh: 你正躲在大綠色扶手椅的後面！

options.hint: 在物體後面要用「behind（在...後面）」喔！
指出小熊 Benny 躲在扶手椅後面喔！

character_line.en: Haha, you found me! Whose brown shoes are in front of the door?
character_line.zh: 哈哈，被你找到了！門前面是誰的棕色鞋子？

options.en: They are in front of the door, ready for a walk!
options.zh: 它們在門的前面，準備好要出門散步了！

options.hint: 回答鞋子就在門的正前方喔！

character_line.en: Listen closely! Who is purring under the dining table?
character_line.zh: 仔細聽！是誰在餐桌底下發出呼嚕呼嚕聲？

options.en: A cute little kitten is sleeping under the table!
options.zh: 一隻可愛的小貓咪正在桌子底下睡覺！

options.hint: 在下方或下面要用「under（在...底下）」喔！
告訴 Benny 桌子底下睡著一隻小貓咪！

character_line.en: Shh, let her sleep! What is sitting on top of the table?
character_line.zh: 噓，讓她好好睡！那桌子上方放著什麼呢？

options.en: A vase of colorful flowers is on the table!
options.zh: 一瓶色彩繽紛的花朵插在桌上！

options.hint: 在表面上方要用「on（在...上面）」喔！
看看桌上擺著美麗花瓶「on the table」！

character_line.en: Look on the sofa! What is tucked between the two soft cushions?
character_line.zh: 看看沙發上！兩個柔軟靠墊中間夾著什麼呢？

options.en: It is a surprise storybook between the cushions!
options.zh: 是一本夾在靠墊之間的驚喜故事書！

options.hint: 在兩者之間要用「between（在...之間）」喔！
告訴 Benny 靠墊中間有一本故事書喔！

character_line.en: You know all the prepositions so well! Where should we read it?
character_line.zh: 你把介系詞學得真好！我們該在哪裡讀它呢？

options.en: Let's sit beside each other and read together!
options.zh: 我們並肩坐在彼此身旁一起讀吧！

options.hint: 坐在旁邊可以用「beside（在...身旁）」喔！
開心地提議坐在一起讀繪本吧！
